name: Youki Hiden ~Ayakashi Gentouwa~
original_name: 妖鬼姫伝～あやかし幻灯話～
source:
An adventure game in which you become the main character, Ryuichi Hihara, and fight monsters called yokai. The story is based on an ancient "agreement" that separates the worlds in which humans and demons live with "doors" to avoid useless conflicts as much as possible.
The pact was signed once every 200 years by those who inherited the bloodline of humans and demons, and was continuously kept. And now, once again, the time to conclude a pact was approaching...

Five heroines appear, and the "attack attribute" and "five elements attribute" differ depending on the character. At the end of the day, you can talk to the characters and deepen their relationship.

[Translated from [url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/%E3%82%A2%E3%82%A4%E3%83%87%E3%82%A3%E3%82%A2%E3%83%95%E3%82%A1%E3%82%AF%E3%83%88%E3%83%AA%E3%83%BC-658032-%E5%A6%96%E9%AC%BC%E5%A7%AB%E4%BC%9D-%E3%81%82%E3%82%84%E3%81%8B%E3%81%97%E5%B9%BB%E7%81%AF%E8%A9%B1-%E9%80%9A%E5%B8%B8%E7%89%88/dp/B000RJZ9C8]Amazon Japan[/url]]
translation:
这是一款冒险游戏，你将扮演主角Ryuichi Hihara，与名为妖怪的怪物战斗。故事围绕一份古老的“约定”展开：人类与妖怪居住的世界由“门”隔开，尽可能避免无谓的冲突。
每隔200年，继承人类与妖怪血脉的人便会签订契约，并世代遵守。如今，新一轮缔结契约的时刻再次临近……

游戏中有五位女主角，每名角色的“攻击属性”和“五行属性”各不相同。你可以在日常中与角色交谈，加深彼此的关系。
